filter.description: Turn one filter on or off

options.duration: For a timeout or a temporary ban, e.g. 10m (empty ban = permanent)

set.description: Tune the thresholds of a filter

options.limit: Limit (meaning depends on the filter, see /automod status)
options.seconds: Time window in seconds (spam, duplicates, files)

exempt.description: Exempt a role or channel, from all filters or from one

filter.description: Only for this filter (empty = all filters)

options.notify: Post a short notice in the channel
options.ignore_staff: Ignore members who can manage messages
options.strike_window: How long a strike counts, e.g. 24h, or "off" for ever

test.description: Check which filters a text would trigger

options.duration: For a timeout (default 10m) or a temporary ban

view.description: Show the strikes of a member

reset.description: Reset the strikes of a member

list.description: Show the banned words (only to you)

links.description: Allowed and blocked domains of the links filter

allow.description: Allow a domain and its subdomains

deny.description: Always block a domain and its subdomains

remove.description: Remove a domain from both lists

mode.description: Block every link except allowed ones, or only blocked ones

choices.allowlist: Allow list (every other link is blocked)
choices.denylist: Block list (only listed domains are blocked)

badwords.name: Banned words
badwords.description: Words from /badwords, with * wildcards. Accents, leet speak (b4d) and spaced letters (b a d) are caught.

invites.name: Invites
invites.description: Discord invites to other servers, even written "discord . gg / code".

links.name: Links
links.description: Links, depending on the allowed and blocked domains of /links.

mentions.name: Mass mentions
mentions.description: Limit = users and roles pinged in one message.

spam.name: Message spam
spam.description: Limit = messages sent within the time window.

duplicates.name: Repeated messages
duplicates.description: Limit = identical messages within the time window.

attachments.name: File spam
attachments.description: Limit = files and stickers sent within the time window.

zalgo.name: Zalgo text
zalgo.description: Limit = stacked accent marks on one character.

caps.name: Capitals
caps.description: Share of capital letters, checked once the message has enough letters.

newlines.name: Line spam
newlines.description: Limit = line breaks in one message.

linkModes.allowlist: Allow list (every other link is blocked)
linkModes.denylist: Block list (only listed domains are blocked)

notice.title: Message removed
notice.warn: {user}, your message was removed and you received a warning: {reason}.

status.title: Automod
status.disabled: Automod is **off**: turn it on with /automod enable.
status.listsValue: {words} banned word(s) · {allow} allowed domain(s) · {deny} blocked domain(s) · mode: {mode}

errors.title: Action impossible
errors.badDuration: Invalid duration. Examples: 10m, 2h, 7d (28 days at most for a timeout).
errors.noStep: There is no step at {count} strikes.
errors.tooManySteps: At most {max} steps. Remove one first.
errors.exemptNothing: Choose a role or a channel.
errors.setNothing: Give at least one value to change.
errors.setWrongParam: This filter has no "{param}" setting. Filters that have it: {filters}.
errors.noWords: No valid word. Words are separated by commas and are {max} characters at most.
errors.badDomain: This is not a valid domain. Example: youtube.com

test.title: Automod test
test.note: Rate filters (spam, repeated messages, files) need several messages and are not tested here.

badwords.title: Banned words
badwords.help: word = whole word · word* = starts with · *word* = anywhere
badwords.filterOff: The banned words filter is off: /automod filter badwords on.

links.title: Links filter
links.filterOff: The links filter is off: /automod filter links on.

modeHelp.allowlist: Every link is blocked except the allowed domains.
modeHelp.denylist: Only the blocked domains are removed; other links pass.

general.title: General
general.description: Master switch, who is ignored, and how long strikes last.

ignoreStaff.label: Ignore staff
ignoreStaff.help: Members with Manage Messages, Manage Server or Administrator are never checked.

notify.label: Channel notice
notify.help: A short message, deleted after a few seconds, tells the member why their message was removed.

exemptRoles.label: Exempt roles
exemptRoles.help: Members with one of these roles are never checked.

exemptChannels.label: Exempt channels
exemptChannels.help: Channels or categories where automod does nothing.

strikeWindow.label: Strikes count for
strikeWindow.help: Each violation adds a strike; escalation steps use the strikes within this time. 0 = forever.

badwords.label: Banned words
badwords.help: One per entry. word = whole word, word* = starts with, *word* = anywhere.

linkMode.label: Links mode
linkMode.help: Allow list blocks every link except allowed domains; block list blocks only listed domains.

action.label: Action
action.help: The message is always deleted; the action can add a sanction.

duration.label: Duration
duration.help: Length of a timeout or temporary ban. 0 for a ban = permanent.

allowOwn.label: Allow own invites
allowOwn.help: Invites to this server are not removed.

limit.label: Limit
limit.help: Triggers when this number is reached (see the description above).

seconds.label: Time window (seconds)
seconds.help: Messages counted over this many seconds.

percent.label: Capitals (%)
percent.help: Share of capital letters that triggers the filter.

exemptChannels.label: Exempt channels
exemptChannels.help: Channels or categories this filter ignores.
